source_refs.note: Exercise 9.2, Question 3 (book p. 272); the book prints no answers for Exercise 9.2; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.explanation:
Yahan teen \(\tan^{-1}\) terms hain: do jama aur ek minus, aur jawab ek mashhoor angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\tan^{-1}\frac{3}{4}\), \(\tan^{-1}\frac{3}{5}\), \(\tan^{-1}\frac{8}{19}\).
Find kya karna hai? Dikhana hai ke left side \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) hai.
Rule kaunsa? Tangent ke jama wala formula (v) aur farq wala formula (vi).
Plan: pehle do terms jorenge, jo natija aaye us mein se teesra ghataenge, aur \(\tan^{-1}1\) tak pahunchenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\tan^{-1}\frac{3}{4} + \tan^{-1}\frac{3}{5} - \tan^{-1}\frac{8}{19}\).
Maloom karna (prove): yeh \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) ke barabar hai.
Tareeqa: ek waqt mein do terms jorte hain. Jama ke liye formula (v) \(\tan^{-1}x + \tan^{-1}y = \tan^{-1}\frac{x+y}{1-xy}\), aur farq ke liye formula (vi) \(\tan^{-1}x - \tan^{-1}y = \tan^{-1}\frac{x-y}{1+xy}\). Teen terms ko ek saath kisi formula mein nahi daal sakte, is liye do qadam.

Pehle do terms jama karein
\[\tan^{-1}\tfrac{3}{4} + \tan^{-1}\tfrac{3}{5}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{\frac{3}{4} + \frac{3}{5}}{1 - \frac{3}{4}\cdot\frac{3}{5}}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{27/20}{11/20} = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{27}{11}\]
Kyun: shart \(xy = \frac{9}{20} < 1\) poori hai, is liye formula (v) jaiz hai. Upar: \(\frac{3}{4} + \frac{3}{5} = \frac{15 + 12}{20} = \frac{27}{20}\). Neeche: \(1 - \frac{9}{20} = \frac{11}{20}\). Dono ka denominator 20 hai, woh cancel ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: neeche minus hai kyunke yeh jama wala formula hai.
Ek aur baat: pehle do terms hi kyun jore? Kyunke \(\frac{3}{4}\) aur \(\frac{3}{5}\) jama ho kar ek saaf fraction \(\frac{27}{11}\) banate hain, aur phir teesra term us se ghatana aasaan hai. Aap kisi aur tarteeb se bhi kar sakte hain, jawab wohi aayega, bas hisaab lamba ho sakta hai.

Ab teesra term ghataein
\[\text{L.H.S} = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{27}{11} - \tan^{-1}\tfrac{8}{19}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{\frac{27}{11} - \frac{8}{19}}{1 + \frac{27}{11}\cdot\frac{8}{19}}\]
Kyun: ab farq hai, is liye formula (vi): upar minus, neeche plus. Is ki shart \(xy > -1\) hai, jo yahan khud ba khud poori hai kyunke dono numbers positive hain.

Hisaab saaf karein
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{(513 - 88)/209}{(209 + 216)/209}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\tfrac{425}{425} = \tan^{-1}1\]
\[= \tfrac{\pi}{4} = \text{R.H.S}\]
Kyun: common denominator \(11 \times 19 = 209\). Upar: \(27 \times 19 = 513\) aur \(8 \times 11 = 88\), farq 425. Neeche: \(1 = \frac{209}{209}\) aur \(27 \times 8 = 216\), jama 425. Upar neeche barabar, to fraction 1. Aur \(\tan\frac{\pi}{4} = 1\), \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) principal range mein hai.
Dhyan dein: \(209 + 216\) jama karte waqt jaldi na kijiye; agar upar aur neeche alag number aaye to fauran pichla hisaab dobara check kijiye, kyunke jawab \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) ke liye dono barabar hone chahiye.

Tasdeeq
\[0.6435 + 0.5404 - 0.3985 = 0.7854\]
\[\tfrac{\pi}{4} \approx 0.7854\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: calculator (radian mode) se teeno angles nikal kar jama aur minus kiya; \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) hi aaya.

blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 9.2 ke jawab chhape hue nahi hain. Is page ka har hal hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Is liye aap apna kaam yahan wale hal se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
